_what: TikTok script (65 to 90 s) for a topical video: the Microsoft 365 outage of Nov 12, 2026 (Nolan 11/13: 'Do all'). Facts only from research/108-topical-three-factpack.md. NOT yet checked by a second model.
_rules: Jokes aim at the company's or the public figure's own reported conduct and at Meatball; never at the viewer, a group, the workers, the women in the reports or anyone's family. No woman from the reports is named. Unproven claims stay attributed (reported, alleged, not confirmed). A line that names a country is said clean. No joke adds a number, a cause, a danger or a claim the fact line does not carry. All drawn: no logos, no game footage, no game characters or art. Captions soften swear spelling (cap_swap). Title, description and caption are clean.

lines.say: Microsoft went down and took your whole damn workday with it. Here's what happened.
lines.vis: Frame 0: Meatball at a desk; his laptop shows a spinning wheel and a sad face. No logos.

lines.say: Meatball's boss couldn't email him. Best fucking Thursday of his life.
lines.vis: Meatball leans back, feet on the desk, an empty inbox on screen, confetti.

lines.say: Thursday, around twelve thirty Eastern, Outlook and Teams started failing. Downdetector showed about a hundred and twenty thousand reports in the U.S. That's a lot of people suddenly free for lunch.
lines.vis: A report chart spiking straight up; office workers (stick figures) walking out with sandwiches.

lines.say: Downdetector says reports came in from seventy-four countries and territories in about an hour. A global fucking snow day.
lines.vis: A drawn globe with little red dots popping up; snow falls on it.

lines.say: Microsoft's explanation: part of its infrastructure was under elevated load. Meatball gets it. He's under elevated load every Monday.
lines.vis: A server rack sweating and wobbling; Meatball next to it under a pile of paper.

lines.say: Microsoft says there's no indication of a cyberattack. Nobody broke in. Meatball checked his own password anyway. It's still password.
lines.vis: A padlock, intact; Meatball types PASSWORD on a login box.

lines.say: It dragged on for more than twelve hours. Long enough for Meatball to forget how to do his fucking job.
lines.vis: A clock spinning; Meatball stares at a keyboard like it is an alien object.

lines.say: One estimate cited by CNN says the cost could top seven billion dollars. Meatball's share: zero. He wasn't working anyway.
lines.vis: A stack of money with a question mark; Meatball napping at his desk.

lines.say: Microsoft apologized and says email is approaching normal levels. Meatball's inbox is back. All four hundred fucking emails.
lines.vis: The inbox counter rolls from 0 up to 400; Meatball's face drops.

lines.say: He told his cat, Sauce, he had to work again. Sauce sat on the keyboard. Sauce is the outage now.
lines.vis: Sauce walks onto the laptop keyboard and sits; the screen fills with random letters.

lines.say: So what did you do with your free Thursday? Because
card: WHAT DID YOU DO WITH YOUR FREE THURSDAY? COMMENT
lines.vis: Back to the frame-0 desk and pose so the loop into m1 is seamless; question in a top-corner pill.
